title: Dedicated end-to-end Fast Live Path
current_requirement: Current accepted position follows the dedicated live path accepted fix -> local persistence -> realtime packet -> authoritative Durable Object current state -> WebSocket -> map render, independently of slower background work.

title: Live-path stage instrumentation

title: Coalesce live renders without losing durable history

authoritative_source: SRC-001 / audit/phase8a/PHASE8A_NEW_05_LIVE_PRIORITY.md

title: 23R P95 Fast Live qualification
current_requirement: Real-device/browser qualification must prove all current 23R Fast Live budgets under representative healthy validated Wi-Fi and normal mobile-data conditions on both target OPPO profiles: 1. accepted current fix -> corresponding visible parent marker: **P95 <= 1.5 seconds**; 2. authoritative backend current-state update -> corresponding visible parent marker: **P95 <= 500 milliseconds**; 3. authenticated parent Live Track activation -> phone fast-mode confirmation or explicit failure/degraded result: **P95 <= 2.0 seconds**. The first two measurements begin after a position is accepted; they do not include waiting for the next physical GNSS/fused fix. History, Atlas, reverse geocoding, R2/history work, route simplification and offline backlog must not head-of-line block the measured Fast Live path. Degraded/offline networks are judged on truthful state, durability, recovery and zero manual intervention rather than the healthy-network latency SLA.
authoritative_source: SRC-001 / audit/phase8a/PHASE8A_NEW_05_LIVE_PRIORITY.md

title: Evidence backlog priority order

authoritative_source: SRC-001 / audit/phase8a/PHASE8A_NEW_05_LIVE_PRIORITY.md
